name: Ciel
source:
Star spirit living with Secyllia. Contrary to his clean appearance, he is sarcastic and foul-mouthed.

Although he only trusts Secyllia and Losa, he never tries to use the power of the Celestial Spirits.

[Translated from [url=http://comodo.starfree.jp/perfumer/chara.html]official website[/url]]
